test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six people M, N, O, P, Q, and R are sitting in a straight line, all facing North.

P is 3rd to the left of R. M is to the immediate right of Q. O is not sitting at any end. Q is not at the extreme left. N is to the immediate left of R and second to the left of Q.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of O?
solution:
Given: Six people M, N, O, P, Q, and R are sitting in a straight line facing north.

1) P is 3rd to the left of R.

2) M is to the immediate right of Q.

3) N is to the immediate left of R and second to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06d3d8f5d94b2d644cd24141e282e896e9c5ad7742e8b85f09fc076ef95f23a4.png] 

4) O is not sitting at any end.

5) Q is not at the extreme left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee753de9bfe166e6daf04b23b14e980ec2c7fbb83e6b59c2f175fe5d8f182f60.png] 

Thus, N is to the immediate right of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option1".**
